facts.text: I've been hearing voices, but there's no one there.

facts.item: hearing voices: what they say about me
facts.text: The voices talk about me in the third person.

facts.item: hearing voices: telling me to hurt myself
facts.text: The voices encourage me to hurt myself.

facts.item: how long the symptoms have been going on
facts.text: This has been going on for the past week, since my father died.
My father died of lung cancer.
I keep getting unwanted thoughts that push their way into my head.
I've never had any medical illness.
I've never had any psychiatric illness before.
I don't use any drugs or other substances.
Apart from the voices, I haven't noticed anything else unusual with my senses.

findings.name: mental status examination
findings.result: Appearance: gaunt and anxious. Behavior: cooperative, but appears distressed. Speech: coherent; reports distressing auditory hallucinations. Mood and affect: euthymic mood with congruent affect; subjectively reports feeling anxious. Thought process: linear. Thought content: reports hearing voices discussing her negatively and encouraging self-harm. Perception: auditory hallucinations. Cognition: alert and oriented to time, place and person; concentration impaired. Insight and judgment: insight somewhat limited; judgment fair.

aliases: brief psychotic disorder with marked stressor

source_issues: Mental status: mood is recorded as 'euthymic with congruent affect' while appearance is 'anxious' and the patient reports feeling anxious.
The Speech leaf contains perceptual content ('reports distressing auditory hallucinations').
The one-week duration in the history is attached to 'bizarre behavior', not explicitly to the voices.
notes: 'Bizarre behavior' and attending with her mother are observer-level information; the MSE leaves do not contain them, so they are in qc.extras.acting_notes, not patient facts.

Psychiatric content is written as experience ('hearing voices, but there's no one there', 'unwanted thoughts') with the clinical terms as aliases. The voices' third-person commentary and their encouragement of self-harm are separate children so a question about command voices gets its own answer; the patient's own intent to self-harm is not recorded and stays unknown.
The mental status examination is one record (mental status is one requestable component); its sub-headings are aliases.
The patient's subjective anxiety appears only in the MSE leaf, not in the patient fragments, so no patient fact was created for it.
'No notable social history provided' (p006) carries no meaning; p006 is cited for the medication and substance denials.
'No history of medical or psychiatric illness' is split into a medical (f008) and a psychiatric (f009) denial.

extras.objective_for_doctor: Assess, manage, and diagnose the patient presenting with symptoms of a psychiatric disorder, following recent bereavement.
acting_notes: Came in with her mother because of bizarre behavior over the past week (reported by others, not a patient statement).
